zh: 週四（11/5）美股重挫，抹掉週三選後大漲：標普 500 下跌 334.89 點、跌幅 4.36%，收 7,353.73；道瓊下跌 1,833.06 點、跌 3.44%，收 51,523.06；那斯達克下跌 5.52% 收 24,315.00，進入修正區間。恐慌指數 VIX 收 28.18，單日大漲約 70%。報導把主因指向 AI 與晶片股的賣壓，以及對沖基金鎖定年度獲利。
en: US stocks plunged on Thursday, Nov 5, erasing Wednesday's post-election rally: the S&P 500 fell 334.89 points, or 4.36%, to 7,353.73; the Dow lost 1,833.06 points, or 3.44%, to 51,523.06; and the Nasdaq dropped 5.52% to 24,315.00, entering correction territory. The VIX closed at 28.18, up about 70% in a day. Reports pointed to selling in AI and chip stocks and hedge funds locking in 2026 gains.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，指數 -5.52%，報導稱那指 100 約 -6.3%

zh: 費城半導體指數單日下跌約 12%，是這波賣壓的核心：輝達收盤下跌 9.12%，英特爾下跌 10.31%，超微盤中跌約 15%。Lam Research 一個月跌 36%、應用材料跌 30%。247WallSt 提到另一個催化因素：各地選民在 41 項地方投票中否決了 40 項 AI 資料中心案，市場解讀為 AI 基建會更慢、更貴。
en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell about 12% in a day, the core of the selloff: Nvidia closed down 9.12%, Intel fell 10.31%, and AMD was down about 15% intraday. Lam Research is down 36% over the past month and Applied Materials 30%. 247WallSt cited another trigger: voters rejected 40 of 41 local AI data-center ballot measures, which the market read as a slower, costlier AI buildout.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，費半約 -12%
收盤約 -10.31%，一個月已跌逾一半
盤中約 -15%

zh: 賣壓不只在晶片：報導說那斯達克 100 單日下跌約 6.3%，市值蒸發約 2.3 兆美元；Palantir 與 CrowdStrike 盤中都跌超過 10%；特斯拉與 SpaceX 因傳聞中的合併牽涉監管疑慮，各跌超過 9%。比特幣下跌 5.99%，約 7.58 萬美元。散戶單日淨賣出 3.58 億美元個股，是 2020 年以來最大的一天。這類數字來自單一來源，用來感受規模即可。
en: The selling was not only chips: the Nasdaq-100 reportedly fell about 6.3% in a day, wiping out roughly $2.3 trillion; Palantir and CrowdStrike both fell more than 10% at their lows; and Tesla and SpaceX each fell more than 9% on regulatory worries tied to a possible merger. Bitcoin dropped 5.99% to about $75,800. Retail investors net sold $358 million of single stocks, their biggest day since 2020. These figures come from one source, so use them for scale.

zh: 避險與商品方面：WTI 原油上漲 3.52% 到每桶 91.22 美元，布蘭特約 98 美元，原因是伊朗協議能否結束戰事仍不確定；黃金上漲 0.64% 到每盎司 4,099.20 美元；十年期美債殖利率 4.837%，下降 0.057 個百分點，顯示有一部分資金流向公債。不過 247WallSt 盤前提到殖利率仍接近 5%，利率壓力沒有消失。
en: On havens and commodities: WTI crude rose 3.52% to $91.22 a barrel and Brent traded near $98 on uncertainty over whether an Iran deal ends the war; gold gained 0.64% to $4,099.20 an ounce; and the 10-year Treasury yield fell 0.057 points to 4.837%, a sign some money moved into bonds. Still, 247WallSt noted that yields were near 5% before the open, so rate pressure has not gone away.

黃金 ETF，金價 +0.64%

zh: Cloudflare 週四收盤先跌 10.45% 到 238.71 美元，盤後公布第三季：營收 7.825 億美元、年增 39%，調整後每股盈餘 0.38 美元（預估約 0.34）。全年營收指引調高到約 29.63 億美元；有來源指第四季指引約 8.45 億美元，高於共識約 7.98 億。盤後股價大漲 17% 到 21%，在當天大跌的背景下是少見的逆勢反應。
en: Cloudflare first closed down 10.45% at $238.71 on Thursday, then reported Q3 after the bell: revenue of $782.5 million, up 39%, and adjusted EPS of $0.38 versus about $0.34 expected. Full-year revenue guidance was raised to about $2.963 billion; one source puts Q4 guidance near $845 million versus a consensus of about $798 million. The stock rose 17% to 21% after hours, a rare counter-move on a day of broad selling.

zh: Airbnb 盤後公布第三季：營收 48.7 億美元、年增 19%，每股盈餘 3.16 美元（去年同期 2.21，預估約 2.85 到 2.91），第四季營收指引 32.2 億到 32.8 億美元，高於約 31.6 億的預期，並新增 120 億美元庫藏股授權。盤後漲幅各報導不同，約 7% 到 10%。旅遊需求仍有韌性，是這個市場少見的好消息。
en: Airbnb reported Q3 after the close: revenue of $4.87 billion, up 19%, EPS of $3.16 versus $2.21 a year earlier and about $2.85 to $2.91 expected, and Q4 revenue guidance of $3.22 to $3.28 billion versus about $3.16 billion expected, plus a new $12 billion buyback. Reports differ on the after-hours gain, from about 7% to 10%. Travel demand still looks resilient, a rare piece of good news in this market.

stocks.n: 盤後約 +7% 到 +10%，Q4 指引高於預期

zh: 同一晚的盤後財報分歧很大，下面的漲跌幅取自單一來源，且它的文字與報價欄位並不一致，只能當方向參考：Atlassian 營收 17.7 億美元但雲端訂閱成長放緩，約 -16%；DraftKings 調降全年營收指引到 63.5 億至 65.5 億美元，約 -18%；Axon 營收與獲利低於預期並下修全年，約 -14%；Microchip 第三季營收指引中點低於共識，約 -6%；Affirm 約 -8%。共同點是「指引」比當季數字更重要。
en: After-hours earnings split sharply the same night. The moves below come from a single source whose text and quote fields disagree, so treat them as directional: Atlassian posted $1.77 billion in revenue but slowing cloud subscription growth, about -16%; DraftKings cut full-year revenue guidance to $6.35 to $6.55 billion, about -18%; Axon missed on revenue and earnings and cut its full-year outlook, about -14%; Microchip guided Q3 revenue midpoint below consensus, about -6%; and Affirm about -8%. The common thread: guidance mattered more than the quarter.

zh: 今天（週五 11/6）早上 8:30 公布 10 月非農就業。經濟學家預估增加約 6.2 萬到 6.5 萬人，失業率 4.2%；9 月只有 2.9 萬人，ADP 週三則給出 8.6 萬人。在股市剛重挫的情況下，數字太強會讓升息預期升溫，太弱則會強化成長擔憂，兩個方向都可能引發波動，小型股對利率尤其敏感。
en: Today (Friday, Nov 6) at 8:30 a.m. brings October nonfarm payrolls. Economists expect roughly 62,000 to 65,000 jobs added and unemployment at 4.2%; September was only 29,000 and ADP showed 86,000 on Wednesday. After a sharp stock selloff, a number that is too strong would raise rate-hike expectations and one that is too weak would deepen growth worries, so either direction can drive volatility, and small caps are especially rate-sensitive.

zh: 週四股市大跌的同時，十年期殖利率下降 0.057 個百分點到 4.837%，這代表有部分資金進入公債避險；但殖利率仍在接近 5% 的高位，對高估值成長股是壓力。12 月會不會升息，取決於非農和下週二（11/10）的 10 月 CPI。我沒有查到最新的利率期貨機率，所以不寫數字，請以 CME FedWatch 為準。
en: As stocks plunged on Thursday, the 10-year yield fell 0.057 points to 4.837%, meaning some money moved into Treasuries; yet yields remain near 5%, a pressure on richly valued growth stocks. Whether the Fed hikes in December depends on payrolls and October CPI next Tuesday (Nov 10). I could not find current rate-futures probabilities, so I give no number; check CME FedWatch.

stocks.n: 7-10 年美債 ETF，殖利率 4.837%

zh: 週三的大漲來自選後不確定性下降，但週四市場開始計價政策面的後果：報導指民主黨拿下國會，可能影響 AI 資料中心的建設與監管；另外各地 41 項資料中心地方投票中有 40 項被否決。這些是政策風險的方向，不是已通過的法律，實際影響要等具體法案與許可規則。資料中心設備與電力供應鏈是最直接的觀察對象。
en: Wednesday's rally came from lower post-election uncertainty, but on Thursday the market began pricing policy consequences: reports said a Democratic win in Congress could affect AI data-center buildout and regulation, and 40 of 41 local data-center ballot measures were rejected. These are directions of policy risk, not enacted law; the real impact waits on specific bills and permitting rules. Data-center equipment and power supply chains are the most direct things to watch.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，AI 基建需求的指標
資料中心電力與散熱設備，政策與需求雙重敏感

zh: AI 硬體鏈中跌最重的是記憶體與儲存：頁面列出的跌幅榜上，美光約 -17.5%、威騰電子約 -17.4%、希捷約 -16.3%、Lam Research 約 -16.4%。這幾檔在本週前就已經從高點下來一段，所以賣壓一部分是獲利了結的加速，不一定是基本面突然變差。判斷要看下一次財報的資本支出與庫存說法。
en: The hardest hit in the AI hardware chain was memory and storage: on the page's decliner list, Micron fell about 17.5%, Western Digital about 17.4%, Seagate about 16.3% and Lam Research about 16.4%. These names had already pulled back from highs before this week, so part of the selling is accelerated profit-taking, not necessarily a sudden fundamental break. Judge by capex and inventory commentary at the next earnings.

en: Energy was one of the few areas not falling with the market: WTI rose 3.52% to $91.22 and Brent was near $98, with uncertainty over an Iran deal holding up oil. ConocoPhillips and EOG both reported Thursday; I did not find their share-price reactions, so I give no numbers. For investors, energy exposure acted as a cushion during the tech rout, but oil itself swings hard on geopolitical headlines.

After-hours moves are quoted inconsistently. Bitcoin fell 5.99% that day, and names tied to both AI and crypto get hit from both sides.

zh: 羅素 2000 週四收 2,729.89 點，下跌 127.06 點、跌幅 4.45%，跌幅與標普 500 的 4.36% 差不多，沒有比較抗跌。這次是科技與晶片領跌，小型股裡的銀行與能源權重大，所以拖累沒有那斯達克那麼重，但流動性差的個股在恐慌日價差會放大。我沒有查到板塊細項，不下判斷。
en: The Russell 2000 closed Thursday at 2,729.89, down 127.06 points, or 4.45%, about the same as the S&P 500's 4.36%, so small caps were no more resilient. This selloff was led by tech and chips; banks and energy carry large weights in small caps, so the drag was lighter than in the Nasdaq, but illiquid names see wider spreads on panic days. I did not find a sector breakdown, so I make no call.

zh: 光通訊元件廠 Applied Optoelectronics（AAOI）在財報前一天盤中就跌約 18%，盤後公布第三季：營收 2.70 億美元，調整後每股盈餘 0.17 美元（預估 0.14），但第四季營收指引 3.85 億到 4.2 億美元，低於共識約 4.27 億，原因是收發器零組件供應瓶頸。需求看起來還在，卡的是供給，這跟多數 AI 硬體股的「需求疑慮」不同。盤後跌幅各處報價不一致。
en: Optical component maker Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) fell about 18% intraday the day before its report, then posted Q3 after the close: revenue of $270 million and adjusted EPS of $0.17 versus $0.14 expected, but Q4 revenue guidance of $385 to $420 million came in below the roughly $427 million consensus because of transceiver component supply bottlenecks. Demand appears intact and the constraint is supply, unlike the demand worries hitting most AI hardware. After-hours moves are quoted inconsistently.

stocks.n: Q4 指引低於共識，供給瓶頸

zh: 雲端客服軟體 Five9（FIVN）第三季營收 3.233 億美元、每股盈餘 0.82 美元，略高於預期，但第四季每股盈餘指引 0.88 到 0.92 美元，低於共識 0.99，公司提到企業銷售週期拉長、整合延遲。報導文字寫盤後約 -18%，報價欄位卻顯示約 -6%，兩者差很多，請以即時報價為準。重點是小型軟體股對指引失望的反應通常比大型股劇烈。
en: Cloud contact-center software maker Five9 (FIVN) posted Q3 revenue of $323.3 million and EPS of $0.82, slightly above expectations, but Q4 EPS guidance of $0.88 to $0.92 was below the $0.99 consensus, citing longer enterprise sales cycles and integration delays. The article text says about -18% after hours while the quote field shows about -6%; use a live quote. The point: small software stocks usually react more violently to guidance disappointments than large ones.

stocks.n: Q4 EPS 指引低於共識

zh: 漢堡連鎖 Wendy's（WEN）拒絕了 Nelson Peltz 的 Trian 提出的約 14 億美元收購提案，盤前股價約 +1.5%。這類消息的重點不是價格，而是董事會認為報價低估了公司，以及 Trian 接下來會不會提高報價或轉向委託書戰。在大盤急跌的日子，併購題材屬於跟指數相關性較低的類型。
en: Burger chain Wendy's (WEN) rejected a roughly $1.4 billion takeover offer from Nelson Peltz's Trian, and the shares were up about 1.5% before the open. The point of such news is not the price but that the board thinks the bid undervalues the company, and whether Trian raises its offer or turns to a proxy fight. On days of sharp index declines, M&A situations tend to correlate less with the market.

stocks.n: 拒絕 Trian 約 14 億美元提案，盤前約 +1.5%

zh: 恐慌日看小型股要注意三件事：一是流動性，成交量小的個股價差變大，市價單可能成交在很差的價位；二是同步下跌不代表基本面變壞，要看財報指引有沒有改變；三是融資與槓桿 ETF 的被迫賣出會放大跌幅。今天 VIX 大漲約 70% 到 28.18，這種日子最好先看，不急著動手。
en: Three things to keep in mind with small caps on panic days: first, liquidity, since thin names see wider spreads and market orders can fill at poor prices; second, falling together does not mean fundamentals worsened, so check whether earnings guidance changed; third, forced selling from margin and leveraged ETFs amplifies drops. With the VIX up about 70% to 28.18, days like this are better for watching than for rushing.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，流動性較好的小型股基準
羅素 2000 成長 ETF，高估值小型股指標

en: Orion Group (ORN, marine and concrete construction) reported Q3 on Oct 27: contract revenue of $256.2 million, up 14%; GAAP net income of $5.5 million, or $0.14 a share (versus $0.08); adjusted EBITDA of $17.9 million, up 37%; and a backlog of $645 million, up from $640 million at year-end. That answers the pool's open question: earnings are recovering. I did not find the share reaction; next check is whether marine margin and backlog keep rising. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Outset Medical (OM, Tablo hemodialysis system) reported Q3 on Nov 4: revenue of $33.6 million, up 14% and 6% sequentially; product revenue of $23.7 million, up 15%; gross margin of 40.7% (versus 39.4%); a GAAP net loss of $14.7 million, narrower than $17.8 million, but a non-GAAP net loss of $12.9 million, slightly wider than $12.4 million. The pool wanted gross margin to hold 42%; it printed 40.7%, short of that, and cash burn has not yet converged. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Lantronix (LTRX, industrial IoT and unmanned-systems modules) reports fiscal 2027 Q1 after the close on Monday, Nov 9, with a call at 4:30 p.m. ET. The company guided EPS of $0.04 to $0.06 versus a consensus of $0.04; analysts expect revenue near $31.98 million, versus $31.2 million last quarter. Management earlier said it expects double-digit revenue growth, led by unmanned systems. The watch points: does revenue really head toward double-digit growth, and does guidance change. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 判讀叢集買進有幾個條件：同一檔、七天內至少兩位不同的內部人用自己的錢買（Form 4 代碼 P），金額與職位比股數重要。對分析師覆蓋少的小型股，訊號通常比對大型股強。6 月的一份分析點名了 Bankwell、Marathon Bancorp、Primis 等小型銀行出現多位內部人買進。要小心的是：小額象徵性買進、或由投資人關係安排的買進，資訊量很低。
en: A few conditions for reading cluster buys: at least two different insiders in the same stock within seven days, using their own money (Form 4 code P), where dollar size and role matter more than share count. For small caps with thin analyst coverage the signal is usually stronger than for large caps. A June analysis named small banks such as Bankwell, Marathon Bancorp and Primis as having multi-insider buying. Beware token-size buys or buys arranged by investor relations; they carry little information.

zh: 判讀政要申報要記幾個限制：議員最晚可在交易後 45 天內申報，所以公開時的價格可能是一個半月前的；金額只給寬區間；很多交易由配偶或信託帳戶執行，申報不揭露是誰做的決定；選擇權要看履約價與到期日才有資訊量。像今天這種大跌日，不要把一個月前的申報當成「有人早就知道」的證據，時間順序本身就不支持。這個頻道只記錄申報，不是買賣建議。
en: Reading congressional filings has limits: members have up to 45 days to file, so the price at disclosure may be a month and a half old; amounts come as wide ranges; many trades run through spouse or trust accounts, and filings do not reveal who decided; and options only carry information once you see strike and expiry. On a day of sharp declines, do not treat a month-old filing as evidence that someone knew; the timeline itself does not support it. This channel records filings only and is not trading advice.

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：週三還在慶祝選後大漲，週四半導體指數單日跌約 12%、那斯達克跌 5.52%，VIX 單日大漲約 70%。報導的解釋有三種：對沖基金鎖定年度獲利、AI 資料中心的政策與民意風險、以及散戶大量賣出。但同一晚 Cloudflare 與 Airbnb 的財報大幅超預期，盤後反而大漲，說明「業績真的好」仍被獎勵，賣壓更像是資金面的而不是全面的基本面惡化。問題是：這是一次擁擠部位的快速出清，還是 AI 硬體需求被重新定價的開始？
en: The most notable thing today: on Wednesday the market celebrated the post-election rally; on Thursday the semiconductor index fell about 12% in a day, the Nasdaq dropped 5.52% and the VIX jumped about 70%. Reports offer three explanations: hedge funds locking in 2026 gains, policy and public-opinion risk for AI data centers, and heavy retail selling. Yet the same night Cloudflare and Airbnb beat estimates by wide margins and jumped after hours, showing that truly good results are still rewarded, so the selling looks more like a flow event than a broad fundamental deterioration. The question: is this a fast unwinding of crowded positions, or the start of a repricing of AI hardware demand?
